value.rationale: The scalar prey submodel naturally produces an attracting 2cycle; when it does, the common static predator reproduction benchmark can be directionally wrong. The result gives a sharp counterattack crossover and two exact opposite reversal witnesses under positive biological parameters. This defines a concrete population-invasion boundary beyond textbook single-equilibrium linearization and with potential for extension to seasonal or stage-structured invasion models.
